newsitem.title: USA: Boardwalk Casino says CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Boardwalk Casino says CEO resigns.

text.p: Boardwalk Casino Inc said its chief executive officer, Steve Greathouse, has resigned to accept another position within the gaming industry.
Greathouse, the company's CEO since March 1997, said, "I'm excited about the prospects that exist for the Boardwalk and wish this company well, but I've received an offer that is very compelling."
Avis Jansen, chairman of the board, said, "The board will begin the process to fill the CEO position immediately."
Boardwalk Casino owns and operates the Holiday Inn Casino Boardwalk in Las Vegas, which is a 642 room hotel and casino on 7.8 acres.
